notes.title: The Responsibility Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/445df24e32bd1c35c78eb137b43a3abae0144cfd.jpg
									
It’s difficult to say what responsibility means exactly. There’s just... so much to it. Raising the orphaned child of your nemesis... remembering to vote... or even brushing your teeth. Responsibility is most certainly a thing.
				
What we can say is that upon investigation we found that responsibility levels among our Accounting+ 	“friends” are at a record low. We here at Crows Crows Crows think that's probably a bad thing and we are disappointed that our “community” does not reflect the responsible values we totally embody, like, 100% of the time.
				
So we're giving all of you a plant to take care of.
										
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/9fdb431421e0beb469054c5dfd4c06ba8b576ac0.jpg
									
This plant is special. I mean sure– It grows, absorbs nutrients and photosynthesises like a regular plant, but this one does it in REAL TIME across ALL COPIES of Accounting+.
										
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/5f21a5f862f993d845730b121a2df066551e25e0.jpg
									
If you open Accounting+ and go to Clovis’ Level Loader you will find our plant and a watering can. We expect all players across every platform to work together to keep our botanical baby healthy and safe while we take our annual winter break.
				
To communicate and coordinate with your fellow plant guardians please head on down on in on over to the Crows Crows Crows Community Discord. We hope that by nurturing this plant together you can all learn what responsibility truly means. As long as one of you doesn't forget to water the plant daily we should be okay.
				
We want to further honour this momentous occasion with a SPECIAL SALE for Accounting+.
										https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/7d42302a2dff590059f22b3b0f70b5ab0f1c7bec.jpg
										
Now, the thing about this sale is that it only lasts for a very specific amount of time. Once it ends the game goes back to FULL PRICE (what a rip-off). However, if you buy copies of the game NOW it means that very soon the “value” of Accounting+ is guaranteed to rise. This makes Accounting+ the best investmen* you could possibly make this week. Call your stock broker and tell 'em to buy a hundred copies of Accounting+.
				
Can you really afford to pass this up?
				
Crows Crows Crows**

*they can't sue you if you don't finish the word
**please follow our developer profile!

notes.title: Shhhhhhhh! Please click very gently!! The PC Gamer is sleeping…
notes.content:
KEEP IT DOWN!

We can very quietly announce that Crows Crows Crows is coming back to Steam! We’ve got a whole coffin full of PC games ready to release this instant- from small PC experiments gone wrong, to our very own Half Life 2: Episode Thr-

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/a6fb101b36ec92d3cc8091366a20a19ad780a2d5.png

SHHHH!!! Don’t say the forbidden phrase!!

Now, before we can release these beauties we need to set a couple of things straight. The last time you saw us on here we’d just released Dr. Langeskov and Accounting. Look at them over there. Waving to us from the past. How little they both knew…

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/40628ccbaa212fa80b531b86143e84a7ed39eff0.gif

Back in those sepia-snapchat filter days Crows Crows Crows was a smaller collection of dangerous individuals, mostly collaborating remotely via morse code or dropbox. But now we are in the future. Now we have MORE PEOPLE. We have a GOOGLE DRIVE. We have AN OFFICE.

And in this office…

IS A HATCH.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/c9a664256304a51f4f7a4b66678cb9e2c127ffaa.png

A voice behind us tells us what to do. We listen to the voice and we feed the creature as much as is needed. We should be happy it's there for us. And look, here it goes, giving us a new direction...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/639ad8357d8e7e73ddc8d2b371e9f0a23baf9f08.png

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/1b5d2184dd9e7c7adaab3939ccc50cab59abacb6.png

Hatch Creature, please leave my sleep undisturbed tonight. We promise we’re going to stop messing around with apps like EAT, itch.io games like The Temple of No and PS VR games like Accounting+. Steam is the future!! We swear!! We’re going back to the future!! Please!! Please!! We'll even bring some of our existing games over to Steam if that'll stop you spooking us!!!

We have multiple non-VR titles in the works. It is important you know that so I am telling you now in no uncertain terms. APART FROM ACCOUNTING+ VR is dead. Heard it here fifth! It’s gone. It is outta here.

Good. Now. We've gotta get the satanic rite out of the way. No way around this one gamers!

OLD ONES FROM THE GREAT BEYOND
JOIN US IN UNHOLY BOND
EVIL WITH UNSPEAKABLE NAMES
WORKING ON SEVERAL PC GAMES
LOTS OF NEW CONTENT FOR YOU TO SEE
IS IT A KART RACER?
IS IT HALF LIFE THREE?
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/d46f97eaba50c5d7f22ac12035ba9184b25cf706.png





https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/902f854f587b15d77cdb32f29367cd88a7de27bf.png

Some of these games we’ve had in production for longer than a year, it’s been a long and difficult road to get to this point but we’re very excited to share what we’ve been working on with all of you! We post secrets & sneaky peeks over on our Discord! Get over on in there, chill out & maybe play some games with the team!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11090111/529dbf4e39f80e4277d5efc16ca81ab3c851b42c.png

We also have a brand new STEAM DEVELOPER PROFILE... But it probably wouldn’t interest you…

Right?


Catch you soon (in a big net),
Crows Crows Crows

notes.title: Crows Crows Crows update Twine title The Temple of No
notes.content:
If you   ve not played The Temple of No before, it   s good, and you should try it. These are the words that the makers of The Temple of No told me to say about their Twine game. The update to the game is also very good. These are not the words that the makers of The Temple of No told me to say about their game. They are words I settled on all by myself without outside influence. Because I am brave, much like any adventurer will need to be, in order to find the new mysteries hidden in The Temple of No. Also: there’s been a vague promise of fire. You should know that from the get-go.
